OPPORTUNITY. MAGNIFICENT COMMERCIAL, INDUSTRIAL, OR LOGISTICS WAREHOUSE FOR SALE. PRICE NEGOTIABLE.

Start up or expand your business with this magnificent warehouse, designed to meet the needs of commercial, industrial, or logistics activities. It stands out for its spacious areas, functional layout, and great versatility, adapting to a wide variety of businesses.

Ideal as a warehouse, logistics center, production facility, distribution center, commercial showroom, or corporate headquarters, it offers excellent potential for both expanding companies and investors.
